scenarioAssumption: Hosted-provider scenarios assume six master artworks (artisan, horse, cart, bell, two backgrounds) with two candidate attempts each. They are price-based estimates, not observed calls.

electricity.reason: No calibrated wall-power meter or GPU power telemetry is available on the Apple M1 test host.
electricity.instructions: Measure whole-system wall power with a calibrated meter during a 60-second render and multiply mean kW by hours; do not label GPU-only data as total system energy.
